risks: ⚠️ Analysts' consensus PT ($88) is BELOW current price ($104) — stock may already reflect near-term upside
US export controls expansion — any new entity list additions targeting Chinese semiconductor fabs = major revenue risk
Kerrisdale Capital / Steamboat shareholder letter (Apr 2026) — corporate governance concerns, parent company structure with ACM Shanghai
China geopolitical risk — US-China tech war escalation; SMIC/CXMT customer bans would devastate revenue

Taiwan contingency — conflict in strait would halt global semiconductor capex including China

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Semiconductor equipment companies are capital-intensive — customer capex decisions are sensitive to global rates. China fabs are government-subsidized so somewhat insulated from global rate cycles.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Equipment manufacturing inflation manageable — ACMR sources many components in China. USD/CNY dynamics affect margins on international sales.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: China WFE spend driven by government mandate, not Fed policy. But US sanctions risk is the primary non-fundamental risk for ACMR.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — primarily geopolitical/export control risk, not rate risk. China semiconductor spend is policy-driven.
